control.title: ISMS scope and context
control.description: Document the organisation's context, interested parties and their requirements, and the scope and boundaries of the security programme.

implementation_notes: Implemented at Paisa Setu Fintech and reviewed annually.
evidence_hint: ISMS scope document and context / interested parties register.
acceptance_criteria: The ISMS scope states which locations, teams, systems and services are included
Interested parties and their requirements are listed
It is approved and dated within the last 12 months

criteria_coverage.criterion: The ISMS scope states which locations, teams, systems and services are included
Interested parties and their requirements are listed

requirements.title: Understanding the organisation and its context
requirements.guidance: List internal and external issues that affect your ability to achieve ISMS outcomes.

requirements.title: Needs of interested parties
requirements.guidance: Identify customers, regulators, staff and others, their security requirements, and which you will address.

requirements.title: ISMS scope
requirements.guidance: Document the scope: locations, teams, products, systems and interfaces covered by the ISMS.

requirements.title: Information security management system
requirements.guidance: Establish, implement, maintain and continually improve the ISMS and its processes.

requirements.title: Clear objectives
requirements.guidance: Specify objectives clearly enough to identify related risks.

evidence.title: ISMS scope and context: how we do it
